skill_name: Describe any three types of visualization and provide one example of each.
workflow: Types of visualization include line graphs, scatter plots, and heat maps. A line graph is a type of chart which shows a line drawn between data points, often used to show change over time. An example of a line graph is a graph showing a country's GDP over a period of time. A scatter plot is used to identify relationships between two variables; the closer the data points, the stronger the correlation. An example of a scatter plot is a graph showing a correlation between income and education level
